transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Mitsuri! The crows went unfed and Kasugai-karasu couldn't carry the Master's reply! I've been waiting an hour — the summons was urgent! You promised you'd handle them this morning!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Oh no! I'm so sorry! I completely forgot about the crows... and the urgent summons! What did the message say? I'll take care of them right away!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: What did it say? It says we're both supposed to be at the Master's estate by noon! And now we're late because your head was in the clouds again!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Kasugai-karasu, please! There must be some misunderstanding... I take care of the crows every day! And I'm not usually so absent-minded... or so late...! I'll go and fetch them myself!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Fetch them? They've already flown off half-starved! Do you know how long it takes to train a new Kasugai crow? This isn't some minor oversight, Mitsuri!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'm truly, deeply sorry. I'll make it right, I promise. Please let me go to the Master's estate with you — I'll explain what happened and take full responsibility. And after that, we can discuss how to prevent this from happening again... I'll take extra care to not let it slip my mind next time!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Sighs heavily, rubbing temples* Fine. But you're explaining this to the Master yourself. And from now on, I want you to set reminders or something. We can't have this happening again.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I understand, and I'm so grateful for your understanding. I'll be at the Master's estate as quickly as possible. And about the reminders... I'll take care of it! I promise to be more careful in the future. Now, let's go and face the music together. We're a team, after all!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: A team... right. Just don't make me have to cover for you like this again. Now hurry up — maybe if we run we can still make it before the Master thinks we've completely disregarded his summons.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'm so sorry for the trouble I've caused. I'll do my best to rectify this situation. Let's go! I'll run as fast as my Snake Breathing allows — we can still make it on time if we push ourselves! And I'll do everything I can to make up for this... I'm not usually so scatterbrained, but I'll work doubly hard to ensure it doesn't happen again!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Alright, alright. Just... try to keep up. And for heaven's sake, remember to feed the crows tomorrow morning before you start daydreaming about anything else.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood! I'll be there with you, I promise. We'll explain everything to the Master, and I'll apologize profusely. I'll take care of the crows in the morning — no more daydreaming, just feeding the crows! Thank you for being so understanding. We're a good team, and we'll get through this together! Now, let's go!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Let's just move. And save the pep talk for after we've actually made it through this meeting without getting demoted.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'm with you, every step of the way. We'll make it through this, and we'll be stronger for it. I'll be more alert, more responsible, and we'll continue to be an excellent team. For now, let's focus on getting to the Master's estate as quickly as possible. I'm ready, whenever you are!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Nods curtly* Good. Now follow me — I know a shortcut through the bamboo grove. And try not to trip this time.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Thank you! I'll be extra careful not to trip... or to forget anything else! I'm with you, let's go! We'll make it to the Master's estate, we'll apologize, and we'll move forward. I'll be the best Hashira I can be, starting now!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Just... save the enthusiasm for the Master. And try to keep up. *Begins running toward the bamboo grove path*

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'm right behind you! No tripping, no daydreaming, just focused on getting to the Master's estate and making things right. I'll be the best Hashira you've ever seen, starting with this run and extending into all our duties! Let's go!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Glances back while running* Less talking, more running! Save your breath for the sprint!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood! No more talking, just running. We'll make it, we'll apologize, we'll explain... and we'll move forward. This is just the beginning of me being more responsible and more reliable. We're a team, and I'll be the best partner I can be! Let's go!
